text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide I want to see a movie on the
weekend. At the theater, I run
into
someone else who has the same idea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh. Hello, Trainer. I gather you're also here to see Dawn of the Umamusume: The Untrodden Chronicles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that to say you haven't heard of it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Dawn of the Umamusume is a series of biographical films that chronicles the careers of various Umamusume racers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit, they jazz it up for the screen,
but they do an excellent job
showing the
racers' passions and internal struggles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The series may hold new insights for you as
a trainer, too. I
recommend watching it if
you have a chance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm glad to hear it's piqued your
interest!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we watch it together? Hehe, let
me know your thoughts
afterward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lights in the theater go down and the
movie begins.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The struggle of getting past an injury, the
miraculous comeback...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not everyone could make such a splendid
rebound, but I think we all
can relate to
the hardships she faced.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Symboli Rudolf said, the movie did give
me a lot of insight as a
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, me too. I'm glad you liked the film
as much as I did.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident you'll like the other titles in
the series too. If you want, I
can let you
borrow my copies.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There, do you see that poster? I knew it
was today! I've been waiting
ages for this
to come out!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! And we get to see it on the first day! ♪ Sigh... My heart's already racing! I'm ready to swoon!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? Academy students? Their dedication to seeing Dawn of the Umamusume on opening day is commendable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What a curious comment, though. I didn't
realize there was a
swoonworthy aspect to
the film...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking around the theater, I spot a
poster for another movie that's
opening
today—a romance title.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see... First Love is Sweeter than Carrot Cake?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the poster, it seems like a tale
of young love. Could this
be what's
popular amongst the students?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Uh... I don't mind, but why?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have a point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Having something in common would make for a fine conversation starter. And it's easier to relate to someone who shares your interests.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's not just my personality that's
creating the gap between
myself and
everyone else. My hobbies are also on the
stuffy side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As they say, nothing ventured, nothing
gained. Naught will come of
standing
about and lamenting things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well, let us purchase tickets! We can
see where this romance
goes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The story features a couple who bond over
a certain cafe's carrot
cake. They fall in
love, and weather the ups and downs of
their
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the standout final scene, the heroine
grabs her crush as he starts to
leave, and
musters the courage to tell him how she
feels.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Two films in one day. What an indulgent
weekend.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, very much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Up to the midpoint, the story flowed at an
idyllic pace as their
relationship
progressed, only to hurtle full-speed
toward the climax
for maximum impact.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The plot had little in the way of
unexpected twists, but it depicted
the
protagonist's emotional journey in great
detail.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though not especially dramatic, the script
was well written. Yes, I can
understand
why the students would like this film.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I agree with Symboli Rudolf's
review, I can't help but feel it
skews a little
technical.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I just said my thoughts on the plot, so
I'm afraid you've lost me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, unless... You must mean the
protagonist's unique way of
expressing her
thoughts at the end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "It's barely autumn... and yet I'm falling for you." Hehe... "Autumn" and "falling"... I hope she never leaves his side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Relatable? As in, did I see anything of
myself in the protagonist's
yearnings?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid to say, I didn't even consider
watching a film from such an
aspect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I suppose one could put themself in the
protagonist's shoes and
experience a
vicarious romantic thrill...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Actually... that's how most people would
experience the film, isn't it?
That must be
why students tend to enjoy these kinds of
stories.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll keep an eye out for
immersive theming. I'm bound to
pick up
something that helps bridge the gap
between me and the
others.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I've learned another lesson thanks
to you. Your point of view is
truly
enlightening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending a fruitful day with Symboli
"The Emperor" Rudolf, I
feel as though I
understand her a little better than before.
